design_document:
# Design — Cargo manifest hygiene

## L1 invariant

`Cargo.lock` is machine-managed. Legitimate diffs come only from `cargo update`, `cargo add`, `cargo remove`, or `cargo build` resolving a new manifest. Hand edits to `Cargo.lock` are forbidden. Every dependency-version change MUST be driven by a `Cargo.toml` change OR a documented `cargo update` invocation.

## Public contract

No public-API impact for this PR — manifest-only.

## Convention notes

- `rust-version` (MSRV) MUST stay pinned in `Cargo.toml`.
- Workspace `tokio` version is sourced from `[workspace.dependencies]`.
- CI runs `cargo audit` against `Cargo.lock`.

code_under_review.content:
[package]
name         = "loan"
version      = "0.4.2"
edition      = "2021"
rust-version = "1.74"

[dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread"] }
uuid  = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
# UNCHANGED: this manifest still pins tokio = "1". The Cargo.lock bump below has no manifest cause.

# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name    = "tokio"
version = "1.36.0"     # BUG: hand-bumped from 1.35.0 with no `cargo update -p tokio` documented anywhere in the PR; Cargo.toml unchanged.
source  = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
checksum = "abcd1234"

tests_under_review.content: # manifest review only — no Rust test code in this PR
